issues.desc: 이기호 (노동부장관 from 1997-08-06) was formally retained in 김대중's first cabinet. On 1998-03-03 he was named among the 17 ministers of the 3·3 조각, reported as the only member of the old cabinet kept, and the 17 ministers received 임명장 that afternoon. This roster keeps ONE spell (1997-08-06..1999-05-24, appointing_president 김영삼) because tenure and ministry name are continuous, and records the 1998-03-03 act as a nomination with outcome appointed. When the panel is split at presidential transitions, the part from 1998-03-03 should be treated as a 김대중 appointment, not as a caretaker holdover. The part 1998-02-25..1998-03-02 is a holdover.

The old release (data/minister_panel_comprehensive.csv) has 15 labor rows and misses every 1998-2003 minister (이기호, 이상룡, 최선정, 김호진, 유용태 and 방용석, the last four flagged in audit/coverage_gaps.csv lines 15, 19, 44 and 53). Its dates are wrong for most rows, for example 권기홍 end 2004-07-01 (resigned 2004-02-10), 김대환 start 2004-07-01 (2004-02-11), 이상수 end 2008-02-24 (resigned 2008-02-01), 이영희 filed under 고용노동부 with end 2010-08-10 (노동부, left 2009-09-30), 박재완 end 2011-06-01 and confirmation_date 2010-11-01, 이채필 2012-03-01..2013-02-24 (2011-05-31..2013-03-10), 방하남 end 2014-07-03, 이기권 2014-07-03..2017-03-10 (2014-07-16..2017-07-24), 김영주 end 2018-11-08, 이재갑 2018-11-08..2021-01-20 (2018-09-21..2021-05-06), 안경덕 start 2021-01-20 (2021-05-07), 이정식 end 2024-07-01 (2024-08-29), 김문수 2024-07-01..2025-06-03 (2024-08-30..2025-04-08), 김영훈 start 2025-07-21 (2025-07-22). It does not split 임태희 at the 2010-07-05 renaming.

Days without an appointed minister are 2000-02-12..2000-02-13 (2 days, 이상룡 resigned 2000-02-11 and 최선정's 임명장 came 2000-02-14, with no gap if his start is taken as the 2000-02-12 announcement and no acting head identified), 2008-02-02..2008-02-28 (27 days, 이상수 resigned to run, 차관 노민기), 2010-07-17..2010-08-29 (44 days, 임태희 moved to 대통령실장, 차관 이채필), 2017-07-25..2017-08-13 (20 days, 이기권 left, 조대엽 had withdrawn, 차관 이성기), 2025-04-09..2025-07-21 (104 days, 김문수 resigned to run for president. 차관 김민석 acted through the 2025-06-04 transition until 2025-06-26, and 차관 권창준, appointed 2025-06-27 per 관보 제21029호, acted from 2025-06-27 until 김영훈 took office. News of 2025-07-09 and 2025-07-12 calls 권창준 '고용노동부 장관 직무대행'). No overlaps except same-day handovers. For 2017 and 2008 no source was found that uses the words 장관 직무대행 with the 차관's name, so the acting entries rest on the vacancy reports plus the 차관's identity (정부조직법 제7조②). VERIFIER: with the disputed 이상수 end moved to 2008-02-04 the 2008 vacancy is 2008-02-05..2008-02-28 (24 days), and the 2010 acting period of 이채필 runs to 2010-08-30 (transcript meeting 39707).

The 고용노동부 역대장관 page ends each tenure on the day before the successor's appointment (박재완 2011.5.30, 이채필 2013.3.10, 방하남 2014.7.15, 김영주 2018.9.20, 이재갑 2021.5.6, 이정식 2024.8.29). These dates are used as end with end_confidence medium. Several news reports suggest the outgoing minister left on the successor's appointment day (for example 2013-03-11), so a same-day end is the alternative. The page also starts 이정식 on 2022.5.11 although the gazette dates his appointment 2022-05-10, and gives only years before 2008. VERIFIER: resolved per case with 이임식 reports. Same-day ends adopted for 이채필 (2013-03-11) and 김영주 (2018-09-21). The MOEL day-before values are confirmed for 박재완 (이임식 2011-05-30), 이재갑 (이임식 2021-05-06), 이정식 (이임식 2024-08-29) and 방하남 (successor's 재가 2014-07-15, no 이임식 report found).

Appointment dates differ between 재가, gazette and 임명장 in several cases. The gazette date is used throughout, for example 이채필 (gazette 2011-05-31, 임명장 2011-06-02), 이기권 (재가 2014-07-15, gazette 2014-07-16), 안경덕 (재가 2021-05-06, term from 2021-05-07), 김문수 (재가 2024-08-29, gazette and 임명장 2024-08-30) and 김영훈 (재가 2025-07-21, gazette 2025-07-22, 임명장 2025-07-23). Before 2001 there is no digital gazette, so 이기호 (1997-08-05 announcement, 임명장 1997-08-06) and 최선정 (2000-02-12 announcement, 임명장 2000-02-14) use the 임명장 day, with medium confidence.

ko.wikipedia '대한민국 고용노동부 장관' (oldid 42117776) has errors and was used only for leads. It dates 이상수 from his nomination (2006-01-02) to 2008-02-29, 이영희 from 2008-03-01, 김대환 from 2004-02-10, 임태희 as 노동부장관 from 2009-10-01 (취임식) and as 고용노동부장관 until 2010-08-30, 이채필 linked as '이재필' and dated from 2011-06-02, 이기권 until 2017-07-25, 이기호 until 1999-05-25.

임태희's move from 노동부 to 고용노동부 on 2010-07-05 is coded reorg_continuation=true and reappointed_on_reorg=false. No 고용노동부장관 appointment notice exists in the 13 harvested 2010-07 인사 items, but gazette absence is not proof. The 2025-10-01 reorganization that created 성평등가족부 took functions from 고용노동부 without renaming it, so 김영훈's spell is not split.

Birth dates are secondary (ko.wikipedia bios) except where na_members_15_22.csv also has them (유용태, 방용석, 이상수, 임태희, 박재완, 김영주, 김문수). 이상룡 (1934), 김호진 (1939) and 권기홍 (1949) have only the disambiguation year of their ko.wikipedia red links. 김영주's NA API date 1955-07-27 is lunar per ko.wikipedia (solar 1955-09-13). English names are from English Wikipedia interlanguage titles (secondary) except 김영훈 (ministry English site). Several ministers have no English name recorded.

Naver News search intermittently returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-25 (shared throttle), and the toolkit helper src.naver_news_search returned no URLs because result links are no longer written with an https:// prefix. labor_04_news_batch.py uses its own tolerant regex through src.fetch. Most news evidence therefore comes from BigKinds metadata (title, date, outlet, snippet) plus Naver articles already in the shared cache, re-fetched and snapshotted here.

verification.summary: 22 spells, 22 nominations and 5 acting records checked. No holder or nomination was missing. Two end dates were corrected to same-day handovers on the basis of 이임식 reports (이채필 2013-03-10 -> 2013-03-11, 김영주 2018-09-20 -> 2018-09-21). 이상수's end moved 2008-02-01 -> 2008-02-04 (퇴임식) and is marked disputed, and 최선정's start (2000-02-12 vs 02-14) is marked disputed. 이영희's end confidence was raised to high (퇴임식 2009-09-30). Two acting records were adjusted. All 17 gazette-backed starts were re-read and match. Independent sources were appended to every spell.
